title: Good: yencoding pending_escape flag correctly handles split-line escape sequences
description: yencoding/src/decode.rs: yEnc escape sequences (=<byte>) can legally be split across line boundaries — the '=' appears at the end of one line and the escaped byte appears at the start of the next. The decoder carries a pending_escape: bool flag across the LineIter, which means it correctly reassembles these split sequences without re-reading the previous line or buffering. This is subtle: getting it wrong would silently corrupt data or miscount byte offsets. The flag is reset on each line start correctly, and dot-stuffing removal happens before pending-escape resolution in the correct order. Worth defending because a naive line-at-a-time decoder would get this wrong.
close_reason: Positive review finding — design decision worth defending. No change needed.
